property.name: Velaa Lagoon Resort & Spa
property.description: A five-star private island wrapped in a house reef, with overwater villas, three restaurants and an award-winning spa suspended above the lagoon.

property.name: Kaani Beach Hotel
property.description: Contemporary beachfront hotel steps from the bikini beach, ideal for travellers who want island life with easy speedboat access from Malé.

property.name: Dhigurah Sands Guesthouse
property.description: Family-run guesthouse on a 3 km sand-spit island famous for year-round whale shark sightings and relaxed local-island living.

property.name: Blue Horizon Safari Boat
property.description: Seven-night liveaboard cruising the central atolls with two to three dives a day, sandbank picnics and surf breaks depending on the season.

addon.name: Romantic Sandbank Dinner
addon.description: Private 5-course dinner on a private sandbank.

addon.name: In-Villa Breakfast Setup
addon.description: Floating breakfast tray served in your pool.

addon.name: 3-Dive Discovery Package
addon.description: Guided reef dives with full equipment rental.

addon.name: Dolphin Cruise Excursion
addon.description: Two-hour sunset dolphin safari with refreshments.

lead.notes: Liveaboard diver — wants 7 nights with dive package.
